message: Hi, I'd like a quote on the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty. I'm ready to buy today — could you do $65,000 total for both?

Thanks for reaching out, and great choice: the T75 with the 3-year extended warranty is a strong package for larger acreage. List on the two together is $70,400. Since you're ready to buy today, I can do $68,500 total for the T75 Row-Crop plus the 3-year extended warranty, covering parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty.
Thanks. Can you meet me at $66,500 total for the T75 + warranty? I'll check out immediately.

I appreciate you being ready to check out today. I can't quite get to $66,500, but I'll meet you closer: $67,500 total for the T75 Row-Crop plus the 3-year extended warranty. That's $2,900 off list, and you're ready to go at checkout.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the T75 at $65,950 and the warranty at $2,325. You offer online checkout which I value, so $66,800 total and I'll pay right now.

You've got a deal. I'll accept $66,800 total for the T75 Row-Crop plus the 3-year extended warranty. Your offer id will be issued for checkout, and payment is due at checkout. Thanks for your business!
